create_resnet_model: create a ResNet model with BasicBlock layers for lipreading feature extraction
build_basic_block: build a BasicBlock module with configurable stride, downsample, and relu type
create_downsample_block: create a downsample block using 1x1 convolution or avg pooling for channel dimension change
create_conv3x3_layer: create a 3x3 convolutional layer with configurable input and output planes
